effect_text:
When effects trash this card from the security stack, you may play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP until their turn ends. By trashing your top security card, instead 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP until their turn ends.
inherited_text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
